newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil falls as supply rises on closed arb.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil falls as supply rises on closed arb.

text.p: NWE gas oil fell as weaker premiums and lower futures combined to bring outright prices down by around $3 a tonne.
May IPE gas oil was $2.50 lower at $168.50 around 1200 GMT.
Traders said premiums have come off for nearly all grades as better supply impacts prices. The closure of the arbitrage to Asia was starting to hit European prices.
"The eastern draw had underpinned us (Europe) for two months, but that has now gone," said one trader.
Over two million tonnes of European product headed to Asia during this period.
Diesel cargo premiums were pegged down $2 with bids at May IPE +$11 and offers at +$12-13 cif NWE after four cargoes were sold on Thursday.
"They were all done at once, its natural the premium will drop," said one trader.
Heating oil premiums were also weaker with DIN heard offered at May IPE +$6 cif NWE, about $1 a tonne lower.
